title: The Oasis • Heated Pool • Game Room • Hot Tub
description:
🌵 The Oasis – Mesa’s Color-Splashed Cactus Retreat
From the hand-painted cactus fireplace to the resort-style backyard, this 5-bed | 3-bath home is made for memory-making. Spread out, reconnect, and let every generation claim a favorite hang-out. Whether that’s the chef’s kitchen, the heated pool framed by string lights, or the muraled arcade-packed game room.

 The space 
❤️What Guests Love Most

🌴 Backyard Paradise – Free-heated pool, oversized hot tub, putting green, fire-pit circle with rainbow Adirondacks, & 75" outdoor TV under twinkling bistro lights

🎮 Epic Game Room – Pool table, NBA Jam & Galaga arcades, board-game nook, Smart TV, and a bold wall mural for Insta-worthy pics

🛏 Sleep-Happy Layout – 5 bedrooms (4 kings!) 2 pullout sofas

🍳 Chef-Approved Kitchen – Quartz island, double oven, air fryer, stock-piled spice drawer, & separate coffee/tea bar with Keurig + kettle + pour-over

👶 Travel-Light Perks – High chair, pack ’n play, monitor, kids’ dinnerware & pool toys

📍 Central & Quiet – 20 mins to Scottsdale nightlife, 10–15 mins to Legacy Sports, golf, parks, groceries & wedding venues

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps up to 16)

Bedroom 1 – King Bed • ensuite bathroom • sleeper sofa & workspace • Smart TV (sleeps 4)

Bedroom 2 – King Bed • Smart TV (sleeps 2)

Bedroom 3 – King Bed • Smart TV (sleeps 2)

Bedroom 4 – King Bed • Smart TV (sleeps 2)

Bedroom 5 – 2 Queen Beds • ensuite bathroom (sleeps 4)

Game Room – sleeper sofa (sleeps 2)

🏝 Backyard Highlights

Heated, sparkling pool (included) + hot tub
BBQ & cactus mural by a local artist
Putting green & yard games – cornhole, Giant Connect 4
Fire-pit lounge ringed by colorful chairs for sunset s’mores
Shaded patio with a 65" Smart TV & dining for 10
Plenty of umbrellas for mid-day chill

🎯 Game Room & Arcade

Full-size pool table
NBA Jam + Galaga arcade cabinets
Comfy sectional + 65" Smart TV (stream all the things)

🍽 Chef-Ready Kitchen

5-burner range, double oven, air fryer & microwave
Large island (seats 3) + dining table (seats 8) under woven pendants
Keurig, drip pot, pour-over, frother & starter pods/tea
Full spice library, oils, quality knives & kid-safe dinnerware
Walk-in pantry stocked with blender, slow cooker, Instant Pot, air fryer & more

📍 Location, Location

25 mins → Legacy Sports Complex & wedding venues
15 mins → Downtown Gilbert eateries & craft brews
20 mins → Old Town Scottsdale nightlife & shopping
Groceries, parks, hiking & golf ≤ 5 mins

👋 Good to Know
Superhost-level comms & local tips
Gig-speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs everywhere
In-home laundry, iron, detergent & supplies
Driveway + easy street parking (no garage access)
No pets, parties, or indoor smoking — quiet hours 10 pm–7 am

 Guest access 
The house is exclusively yours, without interruption during your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with:

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Iron/Board
✔ Washer/Dryer
✔ Free Parking

 Other things to note 
★ NO PETS ALLOWED ★
We love those little (and not so little) furry bundles of joy. Sadly, our home is not suitable to accommodate them.

★ NO SMOKING INSIDE ★
Please refrain from smoking inside the home! Any smoking evidence will result in odor removal and furniture cleaning fees.

★ NO PARTIES/EVENTS ★
We kindly ask you to treat our home as your own to preserve its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits.

Thank you very much for your understanding.
